items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I cut a couple of records with Fats. ... It was a trio deal. Fats, Pichon, Paul Barber, and myself.

ctx.x: That's better down there, y'all. Go around, boy.

Take anything you want. And if it be too far, I could, we have to go. We have to go up to Carlton or maybe on the same, but not. He said, well, I'll tell you what to do. He said, I'll give you a little coffee. Well, at that time, taxes wasn't as plentiful as they are now. I mean, you'd go to job bass drumming all on the street car until just before we stopped having so many street cars, you'd have to go to the public service, get a special permit to bring a set of drums or bass violins on the street car because,…
